verdict.rationale: First-party docs state the product can be self-hosted with Docker for free and self-hosted on your own infrastructure, with on-premise enterprise deployment. A Kubernetes probe fix in the releases, the self-hosted API docs, and community hands-on reports of local installs and enterprise deployments corroborate this. missing for 10: in-depth first-party self-hosting/deployment guide content in the pack (e.g. Docker setup docs, system requirements).
